ns2:section.sectionText: AGCM 398 - Publication Development and Production (52 words) Publications are essential communication tools for agricultural organizations, commodity groups and businesses. This course addresses the modern realities of publication production while giving students an experiential learning opportunity to develop and publish their own e-magazine. Students will learn magazine writing style, technical skills including photography and design, and production and e-delivery platforms for agricultural publications. Prerequisite: AGCM 220.
